_notes: 1 post/day across 12 days, rotating book -> film -> album -> repeat, all at 8:00 AM ET.
Slide structure now varies by carousel (3-4 content slides + your closing slide auto-appended), so the feed doesn't read as the same 3 beats every day.
Prompt slides end most carousels with a direct question, built to pull comments, not rage. Provocative through curiosity and relatable specificity, not by being mean or making things up.
Statement/quote slides stay observational, never invented statistics presented as fact.
Stat slides carry the real waitlist number (1009), update this whenever the count meaningfully changes.
closing-slide.png is appended automatically by render.js as the final slide of every carousel, no manual copying needed.
